title: TopologySemanticScopedContext
description: Compact semantic context for one active topology artifact. This is resolver-facing metadata: it exposes catalog ids and bounded value summaries, not graph paths or target ids.

contextId.description: Runtime context identifier, normally the chat artifact id for Visual Workbench topology follow-ups.

surface.description: Runtime surface represented by this context.

catalogVersion.description: Semantic catalog version used to build this context.

catalogHash.description: Hash of the compiled semantic catalog artifact used by topology-service.

availableSelections.description: Semantic selections available in this active topology artifact.

availableOverlaySignals.description: Catalog-backed metric/state signals that can render as topology overlay effects in this active topology artifact.

availableRelationships.description: Callable topology relationships available in this active topology artifact, such as LAG membership, VLAN membership, L3 membership, routing adjacency, site VPN connectivity, or cloud site connectivity.

activeRelationshipInstances.description: Relationships already materialized by the active view binding or existing overlay layers.

contextActions.description: Semantic catalog action ids that apply to the whole topology artifact context.
